keys.statement: Choose extractant boiling points so regeneration takes each one overhead or at the bottom without an extra column; a heavier biocompatible extractant cut the regeneration section from three columns to two.

decisions.mechanism: Boiling order fixes the regeneration sequence.
decisions.operation: Pick extractants with convenient boiling order.

keys.statement: Do not assume infinite extractant selectivity: real selectivities (about 300 here) carry water into the extract and need extra distillation, so use measured distribution coefficients.

decisions.obstacle: Simulated extraction needs fewer columns than reality.

keys.statement: For recovery from a dilute product stream, the product concentration fed to separation (set by the upstream yield) dominates the energy needed per kilogram of product.

decisions.obstacle: High recovery energy from dilute streams.
decisions.mechanism: Energy scales with the solvent or water handled per unit product.
decisions.operation: Raise feed concentration upstream where possible.
